meta.title: Exploring the Hidden Gem of Vietnam: 3 Days in Cat Ba Island 🏝️🇻🇳
meta.description:
Today we explore the ABSOLUTELY beautiful island located in the north of Vietnam just a quick 2 hours from Hanoi, Cat Ba Island. We explore the beaches, Lan Ha Bay, and the food this island has to offer. This video is a more chilled and relaxed vlog because that is exactly how we felt on this island. 

Grab a cup of tea or your favorite beverage and enjoy this relaxed video. Thanks for tuning in once again and see you next time.

TIME STAMPS:
0:00 Coming up  
0:25 Bus ride to pier
1:19 Chloe's Life Hack
1:49 Roza Palace
4:16 the next morning
5:45 Cat Co Beach
7:47 BANH MI
8:33 Boat Tour
10:05 Kayaking
11:29 main character moment
12:33 The Little Leaf
13:21 Final Morning
14:58 Little walk
15:49 Bloopers :)
16:22 Chloe's Cat Ba Circuit

If you're new here, welcome to our channel! We are so glad you're here. We are a married couple from AMERICA🇺🇸(K8) & SOUTH AFRICA🇿🇦(Gustav). We met here in Bangkok, Thailand🇹🇭, fell in love, and finally eloped in March 2023. 💍💍(eeek!) Since 2021, we've been planning adventures, exploring South East Asia on motorbike, trying crazy fruits, and jungle trekking/hiking through some of the craziest places we've ever been. We want to bring you along on our journeys as we do our favorite things in South East Asia, which is HIKING and RIDING OUR MOTORBIKE in beautiful areas. (amongst many other activities haha) 

We hope our channel brings you inspiration in your travels and maybe a few laughs as well. We have a passion for being in the outdoors, capturing the special moments, and of course, sharing it with you. 

If you are interested in this sort of content don't be shy. Hit that subscribe button so you don't miss out ☺️ Thank you for stopping by and see you in the next one :)

#vietnam #catbaisland #vlog
